analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 31, 2026, reporting healthy revenue and profitability growth driven by core business expansion and new branch contributions. Management expressed strong confidence in achieving its revised FY27 revenue guidance of INR 325 crores to INR 350 crores and maintaining PAT margins of 9% to 11%. The AkikoPay platform has completed development, with the Android and iOS versions rolling out new updates to support digital payments, credit products, and upcoming insurance and mutual fund integrations. The company also reported improvements in receivable days and noted that internal accruals and banking limits are sufficient, with no current plans for equity fundraising. Akiko Global Services Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY2026-27, highlighting robust financial and operational performance driven by its credit card sourcing and lending businesses.

guidance.claim: Management revised the FY27 revenue guidance upwards to INR 325 crores to INR 350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management projected a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management stated a long-term CAGR target of 70% to 100% year-on-year for the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of 300 to 325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth of 70% to 100% for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Profit margins are expected to remain with similar profitability in FY27.
guidance.quote: And profit margins will also remain with similar profitability.

guidance.claim: Management has a long-term vision of reaching INR1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: And we have also taken a long-term vision of 2030. We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q1 revenue of around INR65 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR1,000 crores of unsecured book by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

guidance.claim: The outlook for FY27 revenue is expected to be above INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the sourcing pipeline remains healthy and provides good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that personal loan demand is currently growing the fastest among loan products.
India's credit card penetration remains low at approximately 7 to 8 percent of the population.
demand_outlook.quote: Credit card penetration remains relatively low at ~7-8% of the population, indicating significant headroom for expansion compared to global benchmarks.

demand_outlook.claim: Initial response to AkikoPay has been very encouraging with 50,000+ Android downloads.
demand_outlook.quote: The initial response to AkikoPay has been very encouraging. So far, we have done some 50,000+ Android downloads, and we have negligible cost on that.

demand_outlook.claim: Users are actively doing repeat transactions on AkikoPay, indicating long-term engagement and stickiness.
demand_outlook.quote: And user engagement trends are also very healthy. And the most positive thing is that users are actively doing repeat transactions, which will give us confidence with long-term engagement and stickiness.

demand_outlook.claim: Dubai's business has revived from April onwards after experiencing pressure in the last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: And, it has started reviving again from April onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: Only 10% to 12% of people are doing KYC for the 2 lakh limit on AkikoPay, as users are more interested in the 10,000 limit.
demand_outlook.quote: See, I am seeing that only 10% to 12% people are doing KYC for 2 lakh limit. They are more interested in 10,000 limit.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated the company operates 25 branches across 19 cities in India, all on rent or lease.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: Management outlined plans to add a total of 25 branches this year, with new branches recently added or planned in Kolkata, UP, Hyderabad, Indore, and Kerala.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we have added several branches. This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones. Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its company-owned branch presence in multiple cities across India.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Physical branch presence increases conversion rates from 10% digitally to 60% to 80%.
capex_expansion.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

capex_expansion.claim: The total number of branches has increased to 16 across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported an average payout of 3.10% in the unsecured loan segment.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that newly opened branches have started contributing to profitability.
margins_costs.quote: This time, those branches have contributed to profitability, enabling us to deliver good growth this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 14.8 percent for Q1 FY27.
Profit after tax margin stood at 10.3 percent in Q1 FY27.
Q4 margins experienced pressure due to planned investments in branch expansion, technology infrastructure, and AkikoPay scale-up.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that. Some of our money has been spent in technology infrastructure, on the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.

margins_costs.claim: Temporary margin pressure also occurred in Dubai operations due to the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay has a negligible cost model for customer acquisition.
margins_costs.quote: There's no expense, that is completely negligible led model. I mean, even all AkikoPay application downloading is through our cross-sell channel. We are not burning any single penny on AkikoPay because we have made a huge empire, we have 1,500 employees, we have a database of 25 million, so we are going to monetize that.

margins_costs.claim: The cost of acquiring a customer on AkikoPay is INR10 to INR15 compared to INR250 spent by competitors.
margins_costs.quote: Where Paytm, PhonePe or CRED spends around INR250 to acquire a customer, there our cost comes to INR10 to INR15.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company currently disburses approximately 18,000 credit cards and INR 450 crores in monthly loans.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we disburse almost 18,000 cards, plus INR450 crores is your monthly loan disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported receiving 200 to 300 daily credit leads on AkikoPay.
orders_capacity.quote: On AkikoPay, credit leads coming in such as for loans and credit cards, if I look at the daily average, we are getting 200 to 300 leads.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over 450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company successfully disburses 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
orders_capacity.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Partnerships have been built with 40+ banks and NBFCs, including 20 to 25 new partnerships this year.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have built partnerships with 40+ banks and NBFCs, in which 20 to 25 new partnerships have been built this year.

orders_capacity.claim: Almost 70% of sourcing is currently happening digitally.
orders_capacity.quote: The most important thing is that almost 70% of sourcing is now happening digitally, which is improving productivity and making customer acquisition costs better, and targeting capabilities are also becoming stronger.

orders_capacity.claim: The loan business has reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, representing an annual book of INR5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: The total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management confirmed there are absolutely no plans for fundraising for the next 6 months to 1 year.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year. That means there is no plan until then.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the Dubai business faced revenue pressure during the quarter due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai operations faced temporary margin pressure due to geopolitical issues around the Iran region.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed that the Apple iOS version of AkikoPay will be updated on the App Store within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed that insurance and mutual fund integration into AkikoPay will be completed within the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, in the next quarter, you will see business visibility for insurance and mutual funds within it.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted reaching a loan disbursement run rate of INR 1,000 crores by the end of December (Q3).
management_commitments.quote: plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated receivable days are expected to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the iOS version of AkikoPay is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a comprehensive experience in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of 300 to 325 crore with healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features within the month of May 2026.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Ankur Gaba will take over as MD in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects 5 lakh customers on AkikoPay by September 30th.
management_commitments.quote: I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

management_commitments.claim: Mutual fund and insurance products are expected to go live by August onwards.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
